numerical_methods: Nested Brent roots for muB/T and R(T)=1; stable pair sinh/cosh sums; 96/192 term convergence and independent momentum quadrature.

primary_reference.authors: Cheng Tao Yang and Johann Rafelski
primary_reference.title: Cosmological strangeness abundance
primary_reference.reference_precision: One decimal; temperature uncertainty not quoted for this point.
primary_reference.differences: Their calculation includes charge and strangeness neutrality and a reduced hadronic inventory; ours uses full catalogs with muQ=muS=0. Their central net yield is 0.865e-10 versus ours 0.86931818e-10.

fifty_context.citation: Satarov, Mishustin and Greiner (2013), Phys. Rev. C 88, 024908
fifty_context.meaning: Below about 50 MeV their calculated relative antibaryon abundance decreases rapidly; this is not the R=1 criterion.

scope: The calculated crossover rounds to the published 38.2 MeV benchmark. This is equilibrium-model consistency with shared external inputs, not new observational evidence or a kinetic onset/end determination.
